verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              ततो दुःशासनो राजन् शैनेयं समुपाद्रवत्। किरञ्शतसहस्राणि पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान् ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Meanwhile, o king, Dushasana advanced upon the grandson of Sini, shooting thousands of arrows, like a mighty rain-clouds pouring its contents.

verses.sanskrit: स विद्ध्वा सात्यकिं षष्ट्या तथा षोडशभिः शरैः। नाकम्पयत्स्थितं युद्धे मैनाकमिव पर्वतम् ॥२॥
verses.english: Having pierced Satyaki first with sixty shafts and next with sixteen, he could not make him tremble who was fighting steadily like the immovable Mainaka mountain.

verses.sanskrit: तं तु दुःशासनः शूरः सायकैरावृणोद्भृशम्। रथव्रातेन महता नानादेशोद्भवेन च ॥३॥
सर्वतो भरतश्रेष्ठ विसृजन्सायकान्बहून्। पर्जन्य इव घोषेण नादयन्वै दिशो दश ॥४॥
verses.english: And filled the ten quarters with the clatter of his car-wheels, that resembled the rumble or rain clouds. Beholding that Kaurava hero advance upon him Satyaki.

verses.sanskrit: तमापतन्तमालोक्य सात्यकिः कौरवं रणे। अभिद्रुत्य महाबाहुश्छादयामास सायकैः ॥५॥
ते छाद्यमाना बाणैघैर्दुःशासनपुरोगमाः। प्राद्रवन्समरे भीतास्तव सैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥६॥
verses.english: Became seized with panic and began to fly away even before the very eyes of your son. O monarch, when those warriors were thus flying, your son Dushasana.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु द्रवत्सु राजेन्द्र पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव। तस्थौ व्यपेतभी राजन्सात्यकिं चार्दयच्छरैः ॥७॥
verses.english: Stood fearlessly before Satyaki afflicting him with his arrows. He then pierced the latter's charioteer with three and his steeds with four arrows;

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भिर्वाजिनस्तस्य सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः। सात्यकिं च शतेनाजौ विद्ध्वा नादं मुमोच सः ॥८॥
verses.english: Then piercing Satyaki himself with a set of hundred arrows, he uttered his war-cry. Thereupon O mighty monarch, that descendant of Madhu's race, being worked up

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज माधवस्तस्य संयुगे। रथं सूतं ध्वजं तं च चक्रेऽदृश्यमजिह्मगैः ॥९॥
verses.english: Rendered Dushasana's car, charioteer and standard invisible with his swift flying arrows. he then entirely shrouded the heroic Dushasana with his shafts.

verses.sanskrit: स तु दुःशासनं शूरं सायकैरावृणोद्भृशम्। सशङ्कं समनुप्राप्तमूर्णनाभिरिवोर्णया ॥१०॥
verses.english: That subduer of foes then quickly covered Dushasana with his arrows like a spider cntangling a gnat in its web.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरन्समावृणोद्बाणैर्दुःशासनममित्रजित्। दृष्ट्वा दुःशासनं राजा तथा शरशताचितम् ॥११॥
त्रिगर्तांश्चोदयामास युयुधानरथं प्रति। तेऽगच्छन् युयुधानस्य समीपं क्रूरकर्मणः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Then three thousand warriors of the Trigaratta clan versed in battling and of cruel deeds, reaching the car of Yuyudhana.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिगर्तानां त्रिसाहस्रा रथा युद्धविशारदाः। ते तु तं रथवंशेन महता पर्यवारयन् ॥१३॥
verses.english: Surrounded the latter with the mighty division of their car. They on their hearts firmly on fighting and took terrible oaths.

verses.sanskrit: स्थिरां कृत्वा मतिं युद्धे भूत्वा संशप्तका मिथः। तेषां प्रपततां युद्धे शरवर्षाणि मुञ्चताम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: As they rushed to battle discharging showers of arrows, Yuyudhana crushed five hundred of their foremost warriors that marched in their front.

verses.sanskrit: योधान्पञ्चशतान्मुख्यानग्र्यानीके व्यपोथयत्। तेऽपतन्निहतास्तूर्णं शिनिप्रवरसायकैः ॥१५॥
verses.english: They then began to fall down slain quickly by the arrows of the foremost of Sinis, like trees broken by the force of the wind falling down from the top of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: महामारुतवेगेन भग्ना इव नगाद्द्रुमाः। नागैश्च बहुधा च्छिनैर्ध्वजैश्चैव विशांपते ॥१६॥
verses.english: The field of battle, overspread with mangled elephants, 0 king and broken standards and fallen bodies of horses furnished with golden traces and wounded and cut by the arrows of Sini's grandson and rolling in their blood, looked beautiful like a plain covered over with Kinsuka trees decked with blossoms.

verses.sanskrit: हयैश्च कनकापीडैः पतितैस्तत्र मेदिनी। शैनेयशरसंकृत्तैः शोणितौघपरिप्लुतैः ॥१७॥
अशोभत महाराज किंशुकैरिव पुष्पितैः। ते वध्यमानाः समरे युयुधानेन तावकाः॥१८॥
त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त पङ्कमग्ना इव द्विपाः। ततस्ते पर्यवर्तन्त सर्वे द्रोणरथं प्रति ॥१९॥
verses.english: Slaughtered (ruthlessly), the Pandava and the Srinjayas, O mighty monarch, could not find a protector, like elephants sunk in mire.

verses.sanskrit: भयात्पतगराजस्य गर्तानीव महोरगाः। हत्वा पञ्चशतान्योधाञ्छरैराशीविषोपमैः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Thereafter terrified all of them proceeded towards the car of Drona like mighty snakes entering their holes from fear of the king of birds (Garuda).

verses.sanskrit: प्रायात्स शनकैर्वीरो धनञ्जयरथं प्रति। तं प्रयान्तं नरश्रेष्ठं पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव ॥२१॥
verses.english: Slaying five hundred warriors with his arrows resembling snakes of virulent poison, the heroic Satyaki proceeded slowly towards the car of Dhananjaya.

verses.sanskrit: विव्याध नवभिस्तूर्णं शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः। स तु तं प्रतिविव्याध पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Him the fierce bowmen Satyaki pierced in return with five sharp shafts, all straight flying and furnished with golden as well as vulterine wings.

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मपुङ्खैर्महेष्वासो गार्ध्रपत्रैरजिह्मगैः। सात्यकिं तु महाराज प्रहसन्निव भारत ॥२३॥
verses.english: But O Bharata, Dushasana, smiling a little, pierced Satyaki O king, first with three and then with five shafts,

verses.sanskrit: दुःशासनखिभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः। शैनेयस्तव पुत्रं तु हत्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः ॥२४॥
धनुश्चास्य रणे छित्त्वा विस्मयन्नर्जुनं ययौ। ततो दुःशासनः क्रुद्धो वृष्णिवीराय गच्छते ॥२५॥
verses.english: Thereupon the grandson of Sini wounding your son with five swift-coursing arrows cutoff the latter's bow and then smiling a little proceeded towards Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपारशीं शक्तिं विससर्ज जिघांसया। तां तु शक्तिं तदा घोरां तव पुत्रस्य सात्यकिः ॥२६॥
verses.english: Thereat Dushasana, highly enraged and desirous of slaying the Vrishni hero as he was proceeding, hurled at him a lance capable of penetrating through all things.

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद शतधा राजन्निशितैः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। अथान्यद्धनुरादाय पुत्रस्तव जनेश्वर ॥२७॥
verses.english: But that dreadful lance hurled by your son, Satyaki cut-off, O king, with whetted shafts furnished with wings of the Kanka bird.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिं च शरैर्विद्ध्या सिंहनादं ननर्द ह। सात्यकिस्तु रणे क्रुद्धो मोहयित्वा सुतं तव ॥२८॥
verses.english: O ruler of men, then your son taking up another bow pierced Satyaki with his arrows and then uttered a loud war-cry.

verses.sanskrit: शरैरग्निशिखाकारैराजधान स्तनान्तरे। त्रिभिरेव महाभागः शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः ॥२९॥
सर्वायसैस्तीक्ष्णवक्त्रैः पुनर्विव्याध चाष्टभिः। दुःशासनस्तु विंशत्या सात्यकिं प्रत्यविध्यत ॥३०॥
verses.english: He then once more pierced Dushasana with eight arrows made completely of iron and of sharp heads. Dushasana in return pierced Satyaki with twenty shafts of eminents parts.

verses.sanskrit: सात्वतोऽपि महाराज तं विव्याध स्तनान्तरे। त्रिभिरेव महाभागः शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः ॥३१॥
verses.english: He, of the Satvata race of eminent parts o mighty monarch, again pierced him on the breast with three arrows of straight knots.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽस्य वाहान्निशितैः शरैर्जघ्ने महारथः। सारथिं च सुसंक्रुद्धः शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः ॥३२॥
धनुरेकेन भल्लेन हस्तावापं च पञ्चभिः। ध्वजं च रथशक्तिं च भलाभ्यां परमास्त्रवित् ॥३३॥
verses.english: Versed in the use of many excellent weapons Satyaki then cut-off Dushasana's bow with a single bhalla, his gloves with five and his chariot and chariot shaft, with a couple of broad-headed arrows with sharp shafts he cutoff his two Parshni drivers. Then Dushasana, deprived of his car, with his bow burst open, his charioteer and steeds slain.

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तथोभौ पार्ष्णिसारथी। स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः ॥३४॥
त्रिगर्तसेनापतिना स्वरथेनापवाहितः। तमभिद्रुत्य शैनेयो मुहूर्तमिव भारत ॥३५॥
verses.english: Was carried away by the commander of the Trigartta divisions on his own chariot. O Bharata, then the grandson of Sini once more assailed him.

verses.sanskrit: न जघान महाबाहुर्भीमसेनवचः स्मरन्। भीमसेनेन तु वधः सुतानां तथ भारत ॥३६॥
verses.english: But he refrained from slaying him remembering the words of Bhimasena. O Bharata, amidst the assembly Bhimasena before swore to slay your sons. Then Satyaki, vanquishing Dushasana, quickly proceeded in the track in which Dhananjaya had proceeded, Oking.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिज्ञातः सभामध्ये सर्वेषामेव संयुगे। ततो दुःशासनं जित्वा सात्यकिः संयुगे प्रभो। जगाम त्वरितो राजन् येन यातो धनञ्जयः॥३७॥
